name: PROMIS Sleep-Related Impairment Short Form 8a
developer: PROMIS Health Organization and PROMIS Cooperative Group (Buysse et al., 2010)
construct: Daytime consequences of poor sleep, including alertness, sleepiness and tiredness, over the past 7 days.
licence: HealthMeasures (Northwestern University) has made English PROMIS measures available without charge for research and individual clinical use, with the copyright line retained. Since 2024 licence fees apply to translations and to vendor platforms such as Epic and the Assessment Center API. Confirm current terms on Steps to License. Form copyright line: "© 2008-2016 PROMIS Health Organization and PROMIS Cooperative Group".
instructions: Please respond to each item by marking one box per row. In the past 7 days...

items.text: I had a hard time getting things done because I was sleepy
I felt alert when I woke up
items.note: Item code Sleep119; printed with reversed values Not at all = 5 to Very much = 1

items.text: I had problems during the day because of poor sleep
I had a hard time concentrating because of poor sleep
I felt irritable because of poor sleep.
I was sleepy during the daytime.
I had trouble staying awake during the day.

subscales.name: Total
subscales.description: Raw sum converted to a T score.

scoring: Score each item 1 (Not at all) to 5 (Very much); item 2 (Sleep119) is scored in reverse (Not at all = 5, Very much = 1) as printed on the form. Sum the 8 items for a raw score of 8 to 40 and convert to a T score (mean 50, SD 10, US general population) using the HealthMeasures conversion table or the HealthMeasures Scoring Service. Higher T scores indicate greater sleep related impairment. HealthMeasures descriptive bands: below 55 within normal limits, 55 to 59.9 mild, 60 to 69.9 moderate, 70 and above severe (band source: HealthMeasures score interpretation guidance; not printed on the form).
citation: Buysse, D. J., Yu, L., Moul, D. E., Germain, A., Stover, A., Dodds, N. E., Johnston, K. L., Shablesky-Cade, M. A., & Pilkonis, P. A. (2010). Development and validation of patient-reported outcome measures for sleep disturbance and sleep-related impairments. Sleep, 33(6), 781-792. https://doi.org/10.1093/sleep/33.6.781
transcriptionNote: The HealthMeasures search page (itemsUrl) is a form driven search and returned no measure entries, so the items were transcribed from the NIH HEAL Initiative case report form copy of "PROMIS Item Bank v. 1.0 – Sleep-Related Impairment – Short Form 8a" (sourceUrl). Item codes and order follow that form. Punctuation follows the form: items 6, 7 and 8 end with a full stop, items 1 to 5 do not. The form carries no T score conversion table; the T score method and bands in scoring are from HealthMeasures guidance and should be checked against the current scoring manual.
